notes.title: More Achievements, Crash Fix, Animated Items, 50% sale
notes.content:
Achievements:
We increased number of achievements from 2500 to 3448. To get new achievements you just need to spend a bit time in game and they will be granted automatically. If you see high load on your CPU/RAM just restart steam after, we can`t do anything with it and game itself does not use this much resources.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32563937/b89016492c7c6ae6e7cb7eedd7de6b5cc65e60b0.png

Crash Fix:
We also fixed crash that occur every few minutes and hopes it will work for you, let us know is crashes still appears.

Animated Items:
With this update we added new animated steam items, currently there is 3 of them and they have lower chance to drop and legendary rarity, you can trade and sell them on marketplace.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32563937/0acac651ada062fcd514e6343c5792b70dcf56ca.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32563937/7fe128aa317c6eb082169630f3d82906e0275d12.gif{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32563937/1d9c5be6c4fabff919333de494e7fca60c0b63d1.gif

Sale 50%:
For now we start a sale 50% so you can check our new update for a sweet price :)

notes.title: Achievements + Inventory Items + Summer Sale
notes.content:
Achievements
We are happy to announce a major update, with the first batch of 2500 achievements added, and we plan to add 2500 more in the future, with which you can decorate your profile:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32563937/355b60e924f08d873649c91fdef2136dd04fe4d3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32563937/72809f10ab63de15f96aa3efc94b419c4bf67ded.png
Inventory items
We have also added inventory items, which are automatically given out when you are in the game, it takes approximately 2 minutes to give out one item, for a total of 10 items per day. Items can be transferred and sold on the Marketplace
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32563937/7748a32010d83e8856b7482b0f183c0df268b7c6.png
Summer Sale
During the summer sale, we are launching a maximum discount of 73%! It will last for two weeks, don't miss the opportunity to decorate your profile or give this opportunity to your friends for the lowest price possible!

Don't miss more news!
You can also subscribe to our group:
https://steamcommunity.com/groups/GosDev

And on our curated group:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/GosDev

With all questions and suggestions feel free to email GosDevProduction@gmail.com
